Well, being the big Watenda fan I am, I was looking at the artwork,
wondering just who's shruken head he was holding, and I happened
to reread his text.

Does Watenda's ability have to be used immediatly after the card
your trying to cancel? Or could you wait til later, and do something
more insidious -- like cancel the card when your opponent can't
play it again... For example wait until after maneuvers, and
cancel someone's Torn Signpost, Immortal Grapple, etc.?

I've always assumed you couldn't, but I can't find anything that
favors either side. :-/
